title: smime-tree encrypt.rs: AES-128 and AES-256 CEK-generation/encryption blocks are ~40-line duplicates
description: encrypt.rs: the if use_aes256 { ... } else { ... } branches each contain ~40 nearly identical lines: getrandom::fill, Key::try_from, Iv::try_from, encrypt_padded_vec, cek_bytes.to_vec(), OctetString construction, AlgorithmIdentifierOwned. They differ only in key/type sizes (16 vs 32 bytes) and the OID constant. Suggested rewrite: extract an encrypt_content(inner_mime: &[u8], cek_len: usize, oid: ObjectIdentifier) -> Result<(AlgorithmIdentifierOwned, Vec<u8>, Vec<u8>), SmimeError> function, or use a generic helper parameterized by the cipher type.
